region: Geneva · Seneca Lake, Finger Lakes, New York
about: Ravines Wine Cellars is the Finger Lakes winery of Morten and Lisa Hallgren, founded in 2001. Morten was raised on his family’s estate in Provence, studied enology at Montpellier and worked at Château Cos d’Estournel in Bordeaux before arriving in the Finger Lakes in 1998 as chief winemaker at Dr. Konstantin Frank. In 2012 the Hallgrens bought the White Springs winery and vineyards in Geneva, at the top of Seneca Lake, which became their production home alongside the original tasting room on Keuka Lake.

The 2022 Cabernet Franc is entirely estate grown: 71% from White Springs, an east-facing site on Honeoye loam, and 29% from 16 Falls, a west-facing site of clay loam over shale, with vines averaging 20 years old. The grapes were picked by hand and destemmed, then spent two to three weeks on the skins with hand punch-downs and pump-overs. Malolactic fermentation happened naturally in cask, and the wine aged 14 months in three-year-old, 2,000-liter Austrian oak casks, large enough to add texture without oak flavor.

At 12.9% alcohol, it is a fresh, cool-climate red. Ravines’ notes describe redcurrant, cranberry and mountain herbs, then a pure, elegant palate of raspberry with hints of earth and spice. The Cork Report called it one of the best values in East Coast Cabernet Franc. It drew 91 points from both Vinous and James Suckling, and 90 from Wine Advocate and Wine Enthusiast.
